title: Proof audit exercise
source:
Claim C001.
Let Z have the standard normal distribution and let theta_hat_n=Z/sqrt(n).
Then sqrt(n)|theta_hat_n| converges in distribution to a standard normal random variable.
Proof. We have theta_hat_n -> 0 in probability and sqrt(n)(theta_hat_n-0)=Z.
The map g(x)=|x| has derivative one at zero, so the delta method gives the claim.

conclusions.claim: sqrt(n)|theta_hat_n| converges in distribution to N(0,1)
